Anonymized Labor Description: Additional labor required when work is performed in locations with limited access, increased setup requirements, or reduced equipment maneuverability.
Additional labor required when work occurs in areas with restricted equipment access and higher material handling effort.
Additional labor required when personnel, materials, or equipment must travel over non-standard access routes.
Additional labor required when excavation activities cannot be performed using conventional equipment.
Additional labor required when subsurface conditions significantly increase excavation effort.
Additional labor required to adjust existing infrastructure to meet operational requirements.
Additional labor associated with work performed where multiple assets or connections converge.

Apply when a work location cannot be reached using standard access methods.
Apply when additional transportation, lifting, or positioning resources are needed.
